description: Seed telemetry reference library. One entry per observation source: what it emits, which fields it carries, what it costs to collect, how often the evidence arrives, who owns it, and what it observes. Limited to the five estates in plugins/threat_modeling/adversary_path_projector/examples/. Collection status is 'unknown' throughout because no real estate has been surveyed against it: the entries describe what these products and processes emit, not what any organization currently collects.

events.description: One line per HTTP request, format set by log_format.

control_function.note: Detects request-shaped behaviour reaching the application.

observes.rationale: The request to a planted endpoint is visible; installation of the shell is not.

events.description: Session start with user, database and client address.
Session end with duration.

control_function.note: Detects who connected, never what they read. Statement detail needs pgaudit.

events.description: Statement-level record naming the relation and command tag.
Session-class statements including DDL.

control_function.note: Detects which relation a statement touched.

supports.without_it: a scoping failure is invisible until a customer reports it

observes.rationale: Mass UPDATE is visible as statements; encryption of the underlying store is not a database event.

events.description: Sign-in attempt with outcome and factor used.
Registration of a new authentication factor.

control_function.note: Detects authentication outcomes and factor changes.
Detects object reads and writes by principal.

events.description: Allow or deny for a principal, operation and resource. Whether allows are logged depends on the configured authorizer and its log level.

control_function.note: Detects authorisation decisions, not message content.

supports.without_it: ACL existence is asserted and never observed

prerequisites: authorizer logger set to INFO for allows

observes.rationale: A write to an internal topic is one mechanism of lateral movement through cloud services; the authorizer sees the write, not the movement.

events.description: Request record; pairs with its response by request.id.

control_function.note: Detects secret reads by principal and path. Identifiers are hashed within the audit device's scope; raw tokens are never required.

prerequisites: log sink reachable or Vault seals

events.description: One record per API request, at the configured audit level.

control_function.note: Detects API requests only. A process reading a mounted service-account token produces no API audit event; that needs container or host file telemetry.

prerequisites: audit policy configured beyond Metadata for request bodies

observes.rationale: An exec API call is one route to shell execution; execution from a compromised workload process is invisible here.

sources.name: Container and host file access telemetry

events.description: Process-level file access inside a container or on the host.

control_function.note: The source that actually sees a mounted-token read, which the API audit cannot.

prerequisites: an agent or eBPF collector deployed to every node

events.description: Includes the runner that executed the job.

control_function.note: Detects what ran and who triggered it, not what the job did.

supports.without_it: a workflow change reaching a runner unreviewed is invisible

observes.rationale: The job's existence and trigger are visible; the shell commands it ran are not.

events.description: Successful logon, with logon type.
Failed logon.
Process creation; command line only if that policy is enabled.

control_function.note: Detects logon and process activity on the host.

observes.rationale: The resulting session or process is visible; the exploitation itself is not.

events.description: Kerberos TGT requested.
Service ticket requested.

control_function.note: Detects ticket issuance, the domain-wide view of account use.

prerequisites: Kerberos auditing enabled on every domain controller

sources.name: SMB file share object access auditing

events.description: Network share object access check.
Attempt to access an object, with the access mask.

control_function.note: Detects share reads per principal. Enabled per share, so coverage is a property of configuration, not of the product.

prerequisites: object access auditing enabled on each share (two of eleven in the branch estate)
SACLs set on the directories that matter

events.description: Aggregated conversation with byte and packet counts.

control_function.note: Detects that a conversation happened. Cannot see an out-of-band cellular path, which does not traverse the exporter at all.

prerequisites: export configured on the access layer, not only the core

observes.rationale: A hardware implant is observed by the traffic it generates, never by its insertion.
Only egress that crosses this exporter is visible; a cellular modem is not.

sources.name: Network device AAA and configuration accounting

events.description: Administrative command executed on the device, with the authenticated operator.
Port up or down, including a port that has been unused for months.

control_function.note: A dormant port coming up is the earliest network-side sign of an implant.

observes.rationale: A port coming up precedes any traffic the implant generates.

sources.name: Badge reader grant and deny events

control_function.note: Detects physical presence. Owned by facilities and, in most estates, ingested by no security tool.

prerequisites: export from the access control server
identity join between badge holder and directory account

observes.rationale: Physical entry is not an ATT&CK technique. Labelling it T1078 would conflate a person walking through a door with account use.
A badge grant before an interactive logon corroborates that the account holder was present; absence of a grant is the interesting case.

control_function.note: Detects entry to the comms closet. Alerts to facilities, not to security.

prerequisites: change window calendar available for comparison

observes.rationale: Entry to a locked room has no ATT&CK equivalent; it is the enabling act for a hardware implant, not the implant itself.

events.description: Footage exists for a camera and time range. The footage itself is evidence, not an event stream.

control_function.note: Response support rather than detection: reviewed only once something is already suspected.

prerequisites: retention long enough to cover the detection latency of everything else

observes.rationale: Footage corroborates a person and a time. It detects nothing on its own and must never be recorded as a detection source.

events.description: A device racked that is not in the register, or registered and absent.

control_function.note: Detects that the estate no longer matches its register. It is not attack detection: an implant is found because the rack stopped matching the spreadsheet, up to three months later.

supports.control: Port security and network access control
supports.without_it: an unknown MAC cannot be resolved to a physical device

prerequisites: an asset register that is current

observes.rationale: The audit sees the implant after the fact, as an inventory discrepancy rather than as an intrusion.
Control drift is not an adversary behaviour.

events.description: A credential still active for a leaver, or a grant to a space the holder has no reason to enter.

control_function.note: Asks whether access rights have drifted, not whether someone is walking through a door. The monthly interval is the weakness, not the data.

prerequisites: joiners and leavers feed from HR

observes.rationale: Entitlement drift is a control-health finding, not an adversary behaviour.

events.description: Time-series record of a process value or setpoint.

control_function.note: Detects the process effect. The historian records what happened to the plant, not who caused it.

observes.rationale: The historian shows the resulting process state; the command that caused it comes from the HMI or the controller.
A gap in collection is a telemetry-health finding that may also be an evasion symptom; it is not itself a technique.

events.description: Controller moved between run, program or remote modes.

control_function.note: Detects the command and the operator identity, which the historian cannot supply.

prerequisites: HMI audit logging enabled and exported off the control network

sources.name: Remote access and jump host session records

events.description: Keystroke or screen capture where a session manager is deployed.

control_function.note: Detects remote entry into the estate, including vendor access.

prerequisites: session manager in the path rather than direct RDP or SSH

events.description: Immutable record with actor, approver, reason code and prior balance.

control_function.note: The richest evidence in the estate, and nothing currently alerts on it.

supports.without_it: the control's operation is asserted and never observed

prerequisites: export to a store outside the application's own database

observes.rationale: One identity performing both sides of a separated duty has no ATT&CK equivalent: ATT&CK describes what an attacker does to systems, not how an organization divides authority.
Staying below an approval threshold is an attack on a business rule, not on a system.
The intent matches - altering an account's standing - but the mechanism is an authorised business transaction rather than a permission change.

events.description: Captured for quality assurance and sampled for tone, not for fraud.

control_function.note: Detects agent activity. Its recordings are reviewed by sampling, so the derived fields matter more than the footage.

prerequisites: ticket identifier attached to each lookup

observes.rationale: Every action is permitted; only the absence of a reason distinguishes it.
Browsing dormant high-balance accounts precedes the adjustment; it is not itself account misuse.

events.description: Vendor-tuned anomaly score above a threshold nobody internal can explain.

control_function.note: Detects anomalous value movement. Catches bursts; a patient attacker below the velocity threshold is invisible to it.

prerequisites: alert webhook or file feed from the vendor
mapping from vendor customer ids to internal ones

observes.rationale: A fraud score has no ATT&CK equivalent, and forcing one would claim a technique the engine never assessed.

sources.name: Transactional email suppression and delivery records

events.description: A notification that was not sent, recorded in the provider rather than in the ledger.

control_function.note: Detects that the customer was not told. Only meaningful when joined to the ledger, which nothing currently does.

prerequisites: a join key shared with the ledger

observes.rationale: Same intent as hiding mail from a victim, different mechanism: an application feature rather than a mailbox rule.

events.description: One line per redemption the partner honoured.

control_function.note: The earliest external evidence that value left, and in this estate it is reconciled weekly by one analyst.

prerequisites: file retrieval automated rather than emailed

observes.rationale: Conversion of loyalty value to a gift card is a business outcome; the nearest technique would describe data exfiltration, which is not what happened.

events.description: Issued, redeemed and expired points compared against the liability account.

control_function.note: Detects the aggregate no per-event rule sees, including theft split below every threshold.

observes.rationale: A liability variance is an accounting observation. It detects the consequence of many small permitted actions, which no technique describes.

events.description: A customer reporting that points are missing. Frequently the first true detection, and owned by customer service.

control_function.note: Detects the effect, reported by the victim. Triaged for satisfaction, so ten identical complaints look like ten unhappy customers.

prerequisites: correlation across tickets rather than per-ticket handling

observes.rationale: A customer complaint is not an adversary behaviour; it is the consequence observed by the person harmed.

events.description: Which accounts hold which roles at a point in time.

control_function.note: Detects nothing on its own. It is the data without which a separation-of-duties control cannot be evaluated or even known to be intact.

supports.without_it: the threshold is enforced while role correctness is unverified, so one person holding both roles defeats it silently

prerequisites: export including temporary and inherited grants

observes.rationale: An account holding both sides of a separated duty is a control-design condition, not an adversary action.

control_function.note: Detects nothing. It is what turns an unknown MAC on a switch port into a named device or a finding.

supports.without_it: an unknown MAC cannot be judged
the audit has nothing to compare the rack against

prerequisites: kept current at commissioning and decommissioning

availability.latency: as current as the last update

events.description: Normal rates per agent, per customer segment and per period.

control_function.note: Sets the boundary another control applies. Without a stated grouping, learning period, minimum sample count and cold-start behaviour, a threshold is a guess presented as a measurement.

supports.without_it: the vendor's default threshold is applied to an estate it was not measured on

prerequisites: a learning period free of the fraud being measured

events.description: Application-level record of a handled request, with whatever identity the framework attaches.

control_function.note: The only source that sees application intent - which route, on whose behalf. What it does not see is the statement the database actually ran.

prerequisites: structured logging rather than free prose
request id propagated to downstream calls

events.description: A managed or custom rule fired; whether the request was blocked is a separate field from whether it matched.

control_function.note: Sees the request at the edge. A syntactically valid credential-stuffing login passes every rule, so absence of a match is not evidence of absence.

supports.without_it: the WAF's rule coverage is asserted and never observed

prerequisites: allowed requests logged, not only blocked ones

observes.rationale: Volume and origin are visible at the edge; whether an attempt succeeded is known only to the identity provider.

sources.name: Log collector heartbeat and ingestion volume

control_function.note: Detects that a detection stopped working. Without it, every log-based control fails silently and looks like an absence of attacks.

supports.without_it: a dead collector is indistinguishable from a quiet estate

observes.rationale: A source going quiet is a control-health finding. It may also be the symptom of evasion, which is why it is recorded rather than assumed benign.
